decision_scope: Conditional computational shortlist within explicitly declared model/scenario coverage; no experimental material-performance guarantee.
rule: All required axes must pass. No weighted average, compensation or missing-as-zero rule. Pareto comparison follows admission.

required_axes.label: Operating redox window
required_axes.criterion_source: config/project.json: declared model operating window; not a measured stability guarantee.

required_axes.label: Capacity at declared loading
required_axes.criterion_source: Application cutoff pending; do not derive it from candidate ranks.

required_axes.label: Redox-state integrity/stability
required_axes.criterion_source: Required physical/state and chemical-stability criteria must be specified and checked; disproportionation alone is insufficient.

required_axes.label: Intended charge transfer
required_axes.criterion_source: Application cutoff pending; do not derive it from candidate ranks.

required_axes.label: Practical attachment route
required_axes.criterion_source: docs/PRACTICAL_GRAFTING.md plus exact mapped route gate.

required_axes.label: Defined-route thermodynamics
required_axes.criterion_source: Declared nonpositive standard free-energy screen within specified route/scenarios; not a universal experimental synthesis-feasibility cutoff.

required_axes.label: Unwanted motif association
required_axes.criterion_source: Application cutoff pending; do not derive it from candidate ranks.

required_axes.label: Unwanted intersite electronic coupling
required_axes.criterion_source: Application cutoff pending; do not derive it from candidate ranks.

required_axes.label: Loading/spacing sensitivity
required_axes.criterion_source: Compare explicit occupancy, stereochemistry and converged conformer scenarios; no assumed experimental sequence distribution.

required_axes.label: Model of polymer accessibility
required_axes.criterion_source: Assess the specified support, linker and medium. Molecular solubility or SA is insufficient.

proxy_policy: SA, bare molecular nominal capacity, gas-only lambda, stacked geometry and full-segment association cannot replace the corresponding material/route/motif/kinetic quantities.
route_policy: Positive HCl-reference G alone does not exclude a base-assisted route. Base-required candidates remain in the evaluation pool.
intervals: Scenario envelopes are model sensitivities; retrospective benchmark RMSE or a single sigma is not a calibrated candidate prediction interval.
context_policy: Qualified axes share a declared operating environment; route evidence and reaction G share a separate declared reaction context. Reaction medium/temperature may differ from operation, but cannot be silently mixed between route and thermodynamics.
